items: Finds are on loan from the stars till you sleep: wear or use one at once, but it's yours for good only if the night is won
Once you've taken tonight's find, its constellation lights up in full in the sky and the telescope, and a small icon of it twinkles top left

Asleep after the night, you dream it: won, its stars fall into its place in your treehouse ("The Sentry hat is yours"); lost, they drift back into the sky. Your alarm rings when the dream ends, or at any key
Things on loan sparkle in the treehouse: on the hats' floor and on their cards at the stations
Once the night is won, a find you haven't taken yet is gone
